value.rationale: The canonical nonchordal Fano incidence graph and r=2, the first genuinely higher-independence parameter, are intrinsically motivated. The complete integral wedge-of-13-five-spheres classification gives homotopy information not determined by the ordinary Heawood independence or edge-matching complexes, and offers a reproducible benchmark outside inspected closed-form families. No universal theorem is asserted.
